summary: ADR-0094 selects distinct purpose-bound prospective V3 original-intent, effect-grant and receiver-command/ACK issuers and UTEL original-descriptor issuer in dedicated protected-main .github CI environments under Programme credential custody. It selects separate supervised SystemAdmin host identities and stores for V3 attestation, UTEL phase proofs and UTEL external ACKs; Coordination integrates secret-free verifiers with independent purpose-specific public pins, and Programme accepts enrollment. ADR-0088 supplies a custody pattern only. No selected environment, host account, key, pin, transport, recovery route or operational authority is thereby provisioned or qualified. Separate source and operational acceptance must verify custody, enrollment, deadlines and recovery. The operative UTEL cap remains 65,536 pending complete physical-copy accounting; .103 remains attempted-unknown and unreplayed.
title: Separate prospective V3 and UTEL signing principals and custody
